inclusions.text: Licensed English-speaking Egyptologist at every site visit
inclusions.source: A licensed English-speaking Egyptologist accompanies every site visit; private vehicles handle the transfers ashore.
A licensed English-speaking Egyptologist accompanies every site visit; private vehicles handle the transfers ashore.

The Valley of the Kings holds more than sixty royal tombs; the programme includes Tutankhamun's tomb, modest in scale but freighted with the story of its intact discovery in 1922, plus the grander painted corridors of the Rameside and Thutmosid burials.

inclusions.text: Morning walk through the gorge, visit to the Horemheb speos, time at a local café
inclusions.source: The day includes a morning walk through the gorge, a visit to the Horemheb speos, and time at a local café on the bank — tea, hookah if you want it, the river moving past.

itinerary.title: Luxor: West Bank and the temple by night
itinerary.source: The first night is in a Luxor hotel, and the first afternoon goes directly to the West Bank — the necropolis of ancient Thebes, where the New Kingdom pharaohs were buried in the desert cliffs across the river from their palaces.

itinerary.title: Karnak, then board the Meroe at Esna
itinerary.source: After Karnak, the Meroe is boarded at Esna, 55 kilometres south, where the first site of the cruise is already waiting.

itinerary.title: The Meroe sails south toward El Kab
itinerary.source: The Meroe sails south toward El Kab.

itinerary.title: Edfu and the Temple of Horus
itinerary.source: The fourth morning reaches Edfu and the Temple of Horus — the most completely preserved temple in Egypt.

itinerary.title: A full day at Gebel Silsila
Sails to Kom Ombo
itinerary.source: The day allows time at a beach on the Nile's western bank before the visit, and the evening is spent aboard as the Meroe approaches Aswan.

itinerary.title: Aswan: Philae, the dam, the obelisk
itinerary.source: The final morning disembarks in Aswan for the city's three principal sites.
